notes: Class IDs and names are copied from authoritative repository artifacts and cross-checked by FDD_2_Hardware_Taxonomy/tests. Definitions marked 'provisional' are engineering working definitions grounded in dataset provenance; 'pending' means the domain owner must supply the authoritative definition. Severity and thresholds are references to existing configuration, never new values.

models.dataset: combined-12class-v3-hardnegative (textile: Kaggle muhammadharisabid/fabricdefectntu; hazards: source families 'Chimney smoke', 'Fire hazards', 'No helmet', 'Water Leaks'; CME-OPT1 targeted augmentation and Wikimedia hard negatives)

classes.definition: Textile defect category from the FabricDefectNTU source dataset. Authoritative visual definition pending from the textile domain owner (the term is a local/industry label not defined in the repository).
inclusion: Regions annotated 'baekra' in the source textile dataset
exclusion: Do not use for safety hazards or for other textile classes
hard_negatives: Regular weave pattern and texture variation
classes.annotation: Label only with the reference examples from the source dataset until a written definition is approved.

classes.definition: Localized colour deviation in the fabric (shade, dye or tint inconsistency) relative to the surrounding material.
inclusion: Visible localized shade or dye deviation
exclusion: Illumination changes, shadows or camera white-balance shifts across the whole frame
Foreign material on the surface (use contamination)
Liquid marks (use stain)
classes.annotation: Box the region whose colour differs; do not box the whole fabric for global colour casts.

classes.definition: Foreign material, fibres or particles embedded in or lying on the fabric.
inclusion: Foreign fibres, lint, particles or debris on/in the fabric
exclusion: Liquid marks (use stain)
Colour deviation without foreign material (use color issues)

classes.definition: A cut, slit or tear through the fabric.
inclusion: Visible break in the fabric surface along a line
exclusion: Fabric edge/selvedge (see selvet)
Folds or creases without material separation
classes.annotation: Box the full extent of the cut.

classes.definition: Stitch/yarn defect category from the FabricDefectNTU source dataset. Authoritative visual definition pending from the textile domain owner.
inclusion: Regions annotated 'gray stitch' in the source textile dataset
exclusion: Do not use for colour deviation of the base fabric (color issues)
classes.annotation: Label only with source reference examples until a written definition is approved.

classes.definition: Edge-related defect category from the FabricDefectNTU source dataset (spelling 'selvet' as in the data; likely selvedge). Authoritative definition pending from the textile domain owner.
inclusion: Regions annotated 'selvet' in the source textile dataset
exclusion: Cuts through the fabric body (use cut)
classes.annotation: Label only with source reference examples until a written definition is approved. Do not rename to 'selvedge': the class name is part of the model contract.

classes.definition: A mark or discoloured patch on the fabric caused by a substance (oil, dirt, liquid).
inclusion: Localized marks with a substance-like boundary
exclusion: Uniform colour deviation (color issues)
Solid foreign material (contamination)
Liquid on the floor or equipment (safety classes, not textile)
classes.annotation: Box the stained region on the fabric only.

classes.definition: Visible spilled or leaking liquid that the annotation source marked as a chemical/hazardous spill. VISUAL CATEGORY ONLY: the model cannot identify the chemical, its toxicity or its cause.
inclusion: Pooled or leaking liquid annotated as chemical in the source data, including CME-OPT1 targeted positives
exclusion: Clear water leaks (use water leak) unless the annotation guideline marks the liquid as chemical
Textile stains (use stain)
hard_negatives: Rain puddles, tracks and reflective wet ground (CME-OPT1 Wikimedia negatives)
classes.annotation: Requires a documented visual criterion distinguishing chemical spills from water; until then annotate only with source examples. Most positives originate from the 'Water Leaks' source family: see the open conflict in HAZARD_TAXONOMY.md.

classes.definition: Visible open flame (source family 'Fire hazards'), whether or not smoke is also present.
exclusion: Smoke without visible flame (use smoke)
Glow from lamps, screens, sunsets or reflections
classes.annotation: Box the flame region; annotate accompanying smoke separately as smoke.

classes.definition: A person whose head is visible and who is not wearing a safety helmet.
exclusion: Head not visible or helmet status not determinable (occluded, back-lit, out of frame): do not label
Persons wearing a helmet
hard_negatives: Caps, hoods or hair resembling helmets
Helmets held in hand or lying nearby
classes.annotation: Box the head region. A detection does not identify the worker and is not a compliance verdict without operator review.

inclusion: Smoke plumes with or without visible flame
exclusion: Steam, fog, dust or haze where distinguishable
Flames (annotate separately as fire)
hard_negatives: Fog, clouds, low-light grain (EAP-1 noted low-light degradation)
classes.annotation: Box the visible plume; fire and smoke may co-occur in one image as separate boxes.

classes.definition: Visible water leaking or pooled from equipment, pipes or structures (source family 'Water Leaks').
inclusion: Dripping, spraying or pooled water at a leak source
exclusion: Liquids annotated as chemical (chemical hazard)
Rain and outdoor puddles without a leak source
classes.annotation: Box the leak and its visible pooled area. Shares a source family with chemical hazard: see open conflict.

models.task: binary image classification (ResNet18) with Grad-CAM; separate model, not merged with the detector
models.threshold_config: not configured in this taxonomy (QCI-3 rules consume the classifier result)
models.dataset: KolektorSDD (surface defects on commutators; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, noncommercial research)

classes.definition: Surface image with no annotated defect mask.
inclusion: KolektorSDD images with an empty defect mask
exclusion: Any visible annotated defect

classes.definition: Surface image whose QCI-1 mask contains a defect region.
inclusion: KolektorSDD images with a non-empty defect mask
exclusion: Textile fabric defects (detector namespace)

output_record.note: Proposed fields are additive and not yet implemented; the existing /predict contract is unchanged.
